# Who needs a 1099-NEC, and is the data good enough to file?

> Free 1099-NEC pre-flight check: paste your vendor payments CSV and see who crosses the $600 or $2,000 threshold, missing or invalid TINs, blank addresses, bad state codes, duplicate vendors and card payments to leave out. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
